body:
Maya (AE): Heads-up 0% chance MeridianFin wants a 90-day POC. Two asks: eu-west-1 residency and advance credits to cover month-1 ingest.

Jon (AM): Estimated volume?

Tess (SE): Baseline ~400k tokens/mo, big ingest in month1 ~1.1M tokens (embeddings + some generation). Latency constraints.

Maya (AE): Theyre not in our startup program. Requesting a one-off promo for credits.

Arun (RevOps): Please open Deal Desk ticket with proposed terms.

Maya (AE): Proposed terms:
- 90-day POC
- Up to 1.1M tokens month1, 400k tokens/mo baseline months 2-3
- Promo credits: $5k up front, $2k month2, $1k month3 (total $8k)
- No commit required
- Region restriction: eu-west-1 endpoint only
- Security: must provide SOC2 attestation within 10 business days before sending real customer data
- Retention: POC logs retained 30 days

Jon (AM): Condition credits on receiving SOC2 attestation or signed security attestation. Add a 45-day check-in for conversion signals.

Tess (SE): We can spin up a region-restricted hosted endpoint quickly. Private deploy possible but ~5 business days.

Arun (RevOps): Provisional approval for $8k total credits, conditional on Legal sign-off and SOC2 attestation within 10 business days. If not met, invoice consumed usage at list.

LegalOps: Will draft clause: "Credits void if unredacted PII or production customer data processed before verified SOC2 evidence; consumed usage invoiced at list."

Maya (AE): I'll request SOC2 docs and send update.

DealDeskBot: DD-4555 created for MeridianFin POC credits + residency. Pending LegalOps. Last update 1791010150.
